metaDescription: Barbet vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Barbet boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Barbet social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Barbet exposure.
Weight range 35-65 lb (16-29 kg) and grooming needs (Woolly coat high maintenance.) belong in the same Barbet household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Barbet is also monitored for ear infections, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Barbet appointments.
After the Barbet puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Barbet misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Barbet series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Barbet is the gap, not the embarrassment, because parvovirus pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated puppy even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up DA2PP / DHPP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Barbet away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Barbet due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Barbet core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Barbet misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Barbet health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Barbet adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hip dysplasia, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
